overview.title: Leleka is a place for people who want to join a well-organized execution team.
overview.text: We work in reinforced concrete and monolithic construction, but the work environment matters as much as the projects themselves. Our teams include engineers, site managers, foremen and skilled workers who know what is expected and how the work is organized.

story.title: Work across the full reinforced concrete scope
story.text: Our teams work on foundations, walls, columns and slabs. These are real projects where skill, responsibility and team pace matter every day.

values.title: Stable work conditions
values.text: Clear cooperation rules, on-time settlements and work without organizational chaos.

values.title: Strong execution base
values.text: Experienced foremen and managers who can lead the work and onboard new people properly.

values.title: Transparent cooperation
values.text: Clear communication, specific expectations and real accountability across the team.

capabilities.title: You join projects where reinforced concrete has to be delivered properly and without improvisation.

items.title: Commercial projects

career.title: We are looking for people who want to join a strong crew and stay for the long term.
career.text: If you have experience in reinforced concrete, monolithic works or team leadership, check the current roles. If you are still building experience but want real work, we also want to hear from you.

hero.title: Leleka Construction is a building company that grows together with the people on site.
hero.text1: We have operated in reinforced concrete and monolithic works since 2018. We deliver formwork, reinforcement and concreting packages, while also building a stable team for people who want long-term work on clear terms.
hero.text2: Our strength is not only the projects. It is also how the job works from the inside: organized sites, accountable managers, strong crews and direct information flow. That makes it easier to work, learn and stay longer.

framework.title: We do not sell dreams. We offer real work, strong projects and orderly site organization.
framework.text: Our approach to people is built around work quality, safety, on-time arrangements and direct communication on site.
framework.leadText: A strong place for people who want an organized work environment and development on large construction projects.

items.title: Legal and transparent cooperation
items.text: From the start you know the rules, the settlement model and what the team expects from you.

items.title: Organization without chaos
items.text: The site should keep pace, but without improvisation, broken scope or unclear instructions.

items.title: Experienced people on site
items.text: You work with foremen, managers and specialists who know the pace and standards of large projects.

items.title: Real projects and real scope
items.text: From foundations to slabs and walls, the work gives you practical experience, stability and a clear role.

items.title: Respect for work and people
items.text: We value clear communication, quick decisions and normal working conditions instead of empty promises.

hero.title: A reliable partner for reinforced concrete and monolithic works on demanding projects.
hero.text: If you are looking for a contractor who can deliver the scope, keep the site organized and work clearly with the investor or general contractor, this page is for you. It shows how we work and what the commercial cooperation model looks like.
hero.panelText: Warsaw, Wroclaw and investments delivered across Poland.

proof.title: Cooperation built to give the investment side more predictability.
proof.text: For clients, the scope of works is only part of the decision. The way the execution is organized matters just as much. That is why we focus on clear management, accountable crews and communication that supports decision-making on site.

items.title: Clear execution management
items.text: Scope, pace and responsibility are managed in an orderly way, without unnecessary operational chaos.

items.title: Strong execution base
items.text: We work with crews and site leadership who have practical reinforced concrete and monolithic experience.

items.title: Partner-style communication
items.text: Construction projects need fast decisions and reliable information. We prioritize both.

scope.title: We support projects where quality and execution discipline matter.
scope.text: We work on residential, industrial and commercial investments. The execution model is adjusted to the reality of the project, the schedule and the standard expected by the investor or general contractor.

process.title: We work in a simple and business-focused cooperation model.
process.text: Clients should know what to expect at the start, during execution and in follow-up decisions. That is why we run cooperation in a clear rhythm.

steps.title: Scope recognition
steps.text: We start by defining the investment type, work scope, site entry conditions and expected schedule.

steps.title: Execution setup
steps.text: We align the team, supervision and work model to the scale of the project and its requirements.

steps.title: Delivery and communication
steps.text: During execution we focus on quality, work rhythm and communication that helps move the project forward.

cta.title: If you want to discuss a project, contact us directly.
cta.text: We can talk about work scope, team availability, project location and the right cooperation model for your investment.

hero.title: Contact us if you are looking for reinforced concrete work or want to join the crew.
hero.text: This contact page is built mainly for recruitment. If you want to ask about work, cooperation terms, available roles or your possible start date, send a short application and we will come back with a concrete answer.
hero.panelText: Warsaw, Wroclaw and construction projects across Poland.

inquiry.title: Leave your details if you want to join the team or start cooperating on our projects.
inquiry.text: This is the fastest way to apply for work, ask about open roles and discuss your possible start date. The more clearly you describe your experience and availability, the faster we can respond with something specific.

signals.title: Concrete response
signals.text: After receiving your application, we get back to you with information about current opportunities or the next recruitment step.

signals.title: Faster role matching
signals.text: Your experience, location and availability help us quickly assess which role or cooperation model fits best.

signals.title: Clear process from the start
signals.text: You do not need a full CV to begin. A short description is enough, and we can sort out the details in direct contact.

processSteps: You send your core details, experience and availability.
We review the application in the context of role, location and possible start date.
We reply with feedback, follow-up questions or a proposal for the next conversation.

form.title: Send a recruitment inquiry

form.footerText: After submission we can discuss the role, cooperation terms and your possible start date.
